```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":       (14e-6, 10e-6, 20e-6),  # driver branch current
    "L1":      (2.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # driver length
    "L2":      (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),        # cascode length
    "L3":      (2.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS load length
    "gmid1":   (11.0, 8.0, 14.0),      # driver gm/Id
    "gmid2":   (11.0, 9.0, 14.0),      # cascode gm/Id
    "gmid_p":  (9.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # PMOS load gm/Id
    "kload":   (1.0, 0.95, 1.05),      # PMOS load / driver current ratio
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    I = p["I"]
    Iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    CL = spec["cl"]

    # Driver M1: drain (x) sits at its Vgs, so Vds is set by the ladder
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I, vds=0.7)
    mr1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Iref, vds=0.7)   # diode replica of M1
    x = mr1.vgs

    # Cascode M2: source at x, body effect included
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], I, vds=0.6, vsb=x)
    mr2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], Iref, vds=0.7, vsb=x)  # diode replica, stacked on mr1
    vbn = x + mr2.vgs

    # PMOS current-source load, sized for the same density as its reference
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L3"], p["kload"] * I, vds=0.9)
    mbp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L3"], Iref, vds=0.9)
    vbp_gate = VDD - mbp.vgs

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vin", "vss", "vss", m1)            # CS driver
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "ibias", "x", "vss", m2)         # NMOS cascode, gate = vbn
    n.dev("M3", "vout", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", m3)         # PMOS current-source load
    n.dev("Mr2", "ibias", "ibias", "xr", "vss", mr2)     # diode replica of M2 (vbn)
    n.dev("Mr1", "xr", "xr", "vss", "vss", mr1)          # diode replica of M1 (x)
    n.dev("Mn", "vbp", "xr", "vss", "vss", mr1)          # NMOS copy sinking Iref into vbp
    n.dev("Mbp", "vbp", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mbp)        # PMOS diode sourcing Iref into vbp

    # First-order predictions
    vmin = x + m2.vdsat
    vmax = VDD - m3.vdsat
    vdc = 0.5 * (vmin + vmax)
    swing = 2.0 * min(vdc - vmin, vmax - vdc)

    Rcas = (m2.gm / m2.gds) / m1.gds
    Rout = 1.0 / (m3.gds + 1.0 / Rcas)
    A = m1.gm * Rout
    f3db = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rout * CL)
    gbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * CL)
    power = VDD * (p["kload"] * I + 2 * Iref)   # driver/load branch + Mn/Mbp reference branch

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vdc,
        "swing": swing,
        "m1_headroom": x - m1.vdsat,
        "mn_headroom": vbp_gate - mr1.vdsat,
    }
```
